Unload the fixture and visibly stop the Role. No store network dependency or production E2E controls are added.

Browse the isolated Chrome Web Store at full container width without horizontal scrolling or the Chrome-promotion dialog, enter from Add extension at /category/extensions with the app-language hl parameter, render the complete Buster detail page through visible search results and mouse/keyboard autocomplete, preserve the browser process, then navigate to the official AdBlock detail page, install it through the in-page /extensions/install editor with visible permission confirmation and All roles scope (no modal dialog), verify Electron reports the same extension ID, and verify the 960×640 installed view has three grid tracks, no horizontal overflow, a package icon, non-empty description, localized size, and exact ID before and after restart. Then create a future role through visible UI, verify its extension reaches a terminal compatibility status before Role navigation and its temporary native window title is blank, stop its last native tab without shell errors, prove the native window retires, and reopen the same Role with compatibility readiness. Verify required API permissions exclude optional management, require fresh native worker-running and compatibility-ready evidence on initial open, reopen, and application restart; reject generic degraded outcomes and bootstrap deadline expiry as passing evidence. Treat READY as bootstrap-only evidence; inspect post-navigation worker/API errors separately. Expected context-menu duplicate errors must reach callbacks without host IPC exceptions, uncommitted frames must not expose empty URLs, and unsupported tabs.create must report runtime.lastError. The standalone native DNR allocation restart probe is a separate known-failing engine gate; do not count this journey as proof of ruleset updates or complete AdBlock operation. Retain later AdBlock compatibility failures without claiming full AdBlock support, then verify scope after restart, open the in-page /extensions/:id/edit editor to switch to selected roles and disable, cancel then confirm removal through the standard confirmation dialog, and verify sidebar catalogue counts before installation, after installation/restart, and after removal. External store download is a bounded liveness dependency. Generic browser/chrome namespace and native storage.session compatibility are additionally gated by the paired EXTENSION-FILTERING-001 journey and classic/module native probes.
